label: Likely smoke direction
disclaimer: Simple wind model: it follows the forecast wind from your field. It is not a smoke dispersion model.
region: in and around Punjab and Haryana
summary: NASA satellites saw 124 fires in and around Punjab and Haryana in the last day (192 satellite detections).
What was burning: 120 farm fires, 2 industrial, 1 forest, 1 grassland.
Their smoke will likely reach 2856 villages, 109 towns, 450 schools and colleges and 1032 hospitals and clinics.
Depalpur (city): smoke from 19 fires, since about 6:35 pm.
Kacha Pakka (village): smoke from 15 fires, since about 7:40 pm.
Chorasta Mian Khan (town): smoke from 13 fires, since about 4:50 pm.
Most smoke from these fires: Singhe Wala (village), about +217 µg/m³ of PM2.5 around 5:00 pm.
Worst air on a smoke path: Balsamand (town), AQI 500 (Severe, mostly PM10, largely desert dust) around 7:00 pm.
notes: Some smoke paths leave the saved area; places there are not checked here.
